cac971432b5e47.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about GST 2.0 (effective 22 September 2025)?
cac971432b5e47.x: Life-saving cancer drugs were placed under Nil GST, not 5%; individual health insurance and reinsurance are also Nil.

cabf6e39396574.s: Under the GST changes of 22 September 2025, cigarettes attract:
cabf6e39396574.x: Cigarettes attract 28% GST plus cess, an effective burden of 52–88%; they were not moved to a plain 40% slab.

cab9507f9a9d44.s: Under the proposed GST rate rationalisation, the final decision rests with:
o: The Group of Ministers chaired by Samrat Choudhary
The GST Council chaired by the Union Finance Minister
cab9507f9a9d44.x: The Group of Ministers only accepted the Centre's proposal; the final say lies with the GST Council chaired by the Union Finance Minister.

ca8c8058816d07.s: The 11% cotton import duty, withdrawn in August 2025, was originally introduced in:
ca8c8058816d07.x: The 11% duty was introduced in Union Budget 2021 to protect cotton farmers.

ca1581323165c8.s: Ahead of the RBI MPC meeting of 29 September–1 October 2025, the US Federal Reserve cut its policy rate by:
ca1581323165c8.x: The US Fed cut its rate by 25 bps to 4–4.25%, its first cut of 2025.

cae3e22dd60d0d.s: In which year did the US withdraw India's GSP status?
cae3e22dd60d0d.x: The US withdrew India's GSP status in 2019; 9 July 2025 was only the reciprocal-tariff deadline.

ca092e3110b8f8.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the rupee's weakness in 2025?
o: FPI selling added to the rupee's weakness
The unwinding of the Japanese yen carry trade added to it
The RBI targets a fixed level of the rupee
The RBI extended export-proceeds realisation from 9 to 15 months
ca092e3110b8f8.x: The RBI follows a managed float: it curbs volatility but does not target a rupee level. The other three statements are correct.

o: Goods and services imports minus exports
Goods imports minus goods exports only
cad72ffc3bc9b5.x: The trade deficit covers goods only; the current account deficit adds services, income and transfers.

caaee8f8414f22.s: In the IPO grey market, the premium for selling IPO application rights is called the:
caaee8f8414f22.x: The Kostak rate is the premium for selling IPO application rights; GMP is a different grey-market term. (Sequence not possible: the facts carry no dates.)

ca4b77fa706783.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's green economy?
o: India is projected to have 35 million green jobs by 2030
The landscape approach is associated with 2 lakh PRIs
Women hold only 11% of rooftop solar jobs
ca4b77fa706783.x: The PRI figure linked to the landscape approach is 2.5 lakh, not 2 lakh.

caa9907fdeffbc.s: Unclaimed mutual funds identified by the Department of Financial Services in August 2025 amounted to about:
caa9907fdeffbc.x: Unclaimed mutual funds were about ₹3,000 crore; unpaid dividends exceeded ₹9,000 crore and unclaimed deposits ₹75,000 crore.

ca3905640d3a06.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the approved rail multi-tracking projects and PM Gati Shakti?
o: Sanchi is among the associated tourism destinations
India's logistics cost is about 13% of GDP
The projects come under the PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan
Satpura Tiger Reserve is not among the associated tourism destinations
ca3905640d3a06.x: Satpura Tiger Reserve, like Sanchi, is among the tourism destinations associated with the projects.

ca1fcddf1045cb.s: Of the 100 lakh cotton bales the Cotton Corporation of India bought for ₹37,500 crore, how many did it sell?
ca1fcddf1045cb.x: CCI sold 73 lakh of the 100 lakh bales bought at MSP.

ca98df441b7b45.s: Under PM-eBus Sewa, how many fully air-conditioned e-buses were allocated to Andhra Pradesh?
ca98df441b7b45.x: Andhra Pradesh got 750 fully AC e-buses under PM-eBus Sewa, run through PPP in Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities.

ca98268a9f467f.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's solar sector?
o: Installed solar capacity was 117 GW in September 2025
Effective solar capacity was about 85 GW
Solar power reached parity with coal around 2018
India was third among solar electricity producers in 2024-25
ca98268a9f467f.x: Solar reached parity with coal around 2017, not 2018.

cafab85f24eeb6.s: How much new coal-based capacity does India plan to add by 2035?
cafab85f24eeb6.x: The plan is 97 GW by 2035: 70 GW in renewable-rich States and 27 GW elsewhere.

ca38069d1bcc9c.s: The Department of Commerce and APEDA give the Bharat International Rice Conference 2025:
ca38069d1bcc9c.x: The Department of Commerce and APEDA give BIRC 2025 non-financial support only.

ca0312f65f81c4.s: India's Agriculture Export Policy was introduced in:
ca0312f65f81c4.x: The Agriculture Export Policy dates to 2018; 1985 is the year of the APEDA Act.

ca3914aebcfe1e.s: Which district was NOT among those where Andhra Pradesh's seafood-export activity revived after the 90-day tariff pause?
ca3914aebcfe1e.x: Activity revived in Eluru, Krishna, East and West Godavari, Nellore and Prakasam, but not Guntur.

cabb5b42008549.s: Which country dominates advanced semiconductor nodes below 5 nm?
cabb5b42008549.x: Taiwan leads advanced semiconductor nodes below 5 nm.

ca478f67217a30.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about graduate employability and skilling in India?
o: The German dual system is a model of academia–industry partnership
The National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme is a model of academia–industry partnership
Over 12 million graduates are produced each year
ca478f67217a30.x: Only 42.6% of graduates are employable, not 46.2%.

ca5644b6a11208.s: Women hold what share of rooftop solar jobs in India?
ca5644b6a11208.x: Women hold only 11% of rooftop solar jobs.

ca5a175c3c44fa.s: About 97% of India's solar module and cell exports (which grew 23-fold between FY22 and FY24) went to:
ca5a175c3c44fa.x: As much as 97% of these exports went to the United States, not the EU.

ca1f89a2cf70cc.s: Indian dairy farmers receive what share of the retail price of milk?
ca1f89a2cf70cc.x: Indian farmers get 55–57% of the retail milk price, against 35% in the US.

cadf2ed98e288f.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about semiconductors?
o: Silicon, germanium and gallium arsenide are semiconductor materials
N-type doping gives electrons as charge carriers
P-type doping gives electrons as charge carriers
India imports about 90% of the chips it uses
cadf2ed98e288f.x: P-type material has holes as charge carriers; electrons are the carriers in N-type material.

ca76a7f040dc5b.s: SEBI's proposal to allow FPIs in commodity derivatives covers:
o: Non-cash-settled, non-agricultural derivatives such as gold and silver
ca76a7f040dc5b.x: The proposal covers non-cash-settled, non-agricultural commodity derivatives (gold, silver, zinc, lead), not agricultural ones.

cae9a9d6eebc22.s: In UK electricity regulation, RAB stands for:
cae9a9d6eebc22.x: RAB is Regulated Asset Base; RIIO is Revenue = Incentives + Innovation + Outputs.

ca73b2e5062956.s: Union Budget 2026–27 allocated how much to BioPharma Shakti over 5 years?
ca73b2e5062956.x: BioPharma Shakti got ₹10,000 crore over 5 years, not ₹12,000 crore.

ca09625f41412a.s: Which State is among the four identified for Rare Earth corridors in Union Budget 2026–27?
ca09625f41412a.x: The four States are Odisha, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu.

ca639604197e8d.s: Union Budget 2026–27 raised capital expenditure to:
ca639604197e8d.x: Capex was raised to ₹12.2 lakh crore from ₹11.2 lakh crore.

cad4e92353415b.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Union Budget 2026–27 tax proposals?
o: Updated returns are allowed even after reassessment begins
Such updated returns carry an additional 10% tax
The return-revision deadline moves from 31 December to 31 March
The Foreign Asset Disclosure Scheme is a one-time, 3-month scheme
cad4e92353415b.x: The Foreign Asset Disclosure Scheme runs for 6 months, not 3 months.

ca102873ee8c47.s: Under Union Budget 2026–27, Forms 15G/15H are to be filed through:
ca102873ee8c47.x: Forms 15G/15H get single-window filing through depositories; lower/nil TDS certificates get the rules-based automated process.

cae0ac18031dde.s: Under Union Budget 2026–27, TCS on LRS remittances for education and medical purposes is reduced from 5% to:
cae0ac18031dde.x: TCS on LRS for education and medical purposes is now 2%, the same as on foreign tour packages and tendu leaves.

ca7c2052d3d5d0.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's early Budgets?
o: James Wilson presented British India's first Budget on 7 April 1860
R.K. Shanmukham Chetty presented independent India's first Budget on 26 November 1947
R.K. Shanmukham Chetty presented the first Budget of the Republic
Liaquat Ali Khan presented the 1947-48 Budget of the Interim Government
ca7c2052d3d5d0.x: The first Budget of the Republic was presented by John Mathai, not Chetty.

n540328bc8c6.s: The CBDC-based DBT pilots of August 2026, paying PM-GKAY subsidy as e-rupee tokens, were run in:
o: Chandigarh and Dadra and Nagar Haveli
Delhi and Dadra and Nagar Haveli
n540328bc8c6.x: The pilots were in Chandigarh and Dadra and Nagar Haveli, with purpose-bound e-rupee tokens.

new.s: Which GST slabs were abolished under GST 2.0?
new.x: GST 2.0 kept 0, 5 and 18% and added 40%; the 12% and 28% slabs were abolished.

new.s: Under GST 2.0, the move of some goods from 28% to 40% mainly reflects:
o: A real increase in the tax burden
The merger of the compensation cess
A new levy shared only with States
new.x: The jump from 28% to 40% shows the compensation cess being merged into the rate, not a real hike.

new.s: From 22 September 2025, non-ICU hospital rooms above ₹5,000 per day attract:
new.x: Non-ICU rooms above ₹5,000/day attract 5% GST without input tax credit; rooms below ₹5,000 are exempt.

new.s: What name did PM Modi give to the GST 2.0 rate cuts?
new.x: PM Modi called the GST 2.0 changes "GST Bachat Utsav".

new.s: Which GST slab, kept unchanged, gives about 70% of GST revenue?
new.x: The 18% slab yields about 70% of GST revenue and was kept.

new.s: In June 2025, the RBI cut the Cash Reserve Ratio by 100 bps to:
new.x: On 6 June 2025 the CRR was cut 100 bps to 3% in stages, along with a 50 bps repo cut.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the RBI MPC decision of 6 June 2025:
1. The repo rate was cut by 50 bps to 5.50%.
2. The stance changed from neutral to accommodative.
3. The MSF rate and Bank Rate were set at 5.75%.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct; the stance changed from accommodative to neutral, not the other way round.

new.s: How many members does the RBI Monetary Policy Committee have, including the Governor?
new.x: The MPC has six members including the RBI Governor.

new.s: At its 29 September–1 October 2025 meeting, the RBI projected FY26 CPI inflation at:
new.x: The RBI cut its FY26 CPI forecast to 2.6%; 3.1% was the August forecast and 4% the April one.

new.s: Under Flexible Inflation Targeting, the RBI's CPI target is:
new.x: The inflation target is 4% with a band of ±2%.

new.s: India's GDP growth in Q1 FY26 (April–June 2025), the highest in five quarters, was:
new.x: Q1 FY26 real GDP grew 7.8%; 8.8% was nominal GDP growth and 6.5% the figure a year earlier.

new.s: The first monthly PLFS bulletin, for April 2025, put the unemployment rate (age 15+) at:
new.x: MoSPI's first monthly PLFS bulletin, released 15 May 2025, showed 5.1% unemployment.

new.s: The Wholesale Price Index (WPI) is compiled by:
o: The Office of the Economic Adviser, DPIIT
new.x: WPI, like the Index of Eight Core Industries, is compiled by the Office of the Economic Adviser, DPIIT.

new.s: In April–November 2025, the base year of the Index of Industrial Production (IIP) was:
new.x: The IIP used base year 2011-12 in this period.

new.s: The IMF (World Economic Outlook, October 2025) projected India's FY26 growth at:
new.x: The IMF raised its FY26 projection by 20 bps to 6.6%.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (agency – FY26 growth projection for India, October 2025) is correctly matched?
new.x: The World Bank projected 6.5%; the RBI said 6.8%, the IMF 6.6% and the ADB 6.5%.

new.s: The rupee hit its all-time low of ₹89.41 per US dollar on:
new.x: The rupee touched ₹89.41/USD on 21 November 2025 before rebounding.

new.s: A rise in the Real Effective Exchange Rate (REER) indicates:
new.x: REER is inflation-adjusted; a rise means a loss of competitiveness.

new.s: Which South Asian country has the highest unexploited intra-regional trade potential, at 93%?
new.x: Over 86% of South Asia's trade potential is unexploited, with Bangladesh highest at 93%.

new.s: Among sectors hit by the US 50% tariff, which has the highest US share of India's exports (58.6%)?
new.x: Carpets have the highest US share (58.6%); organic chemicals' share is only 13.2%.

new.s: At the Global Fintech Fest (October 2025), NPCI enabled UPI payments using:
o: Biometric authentication instead of a PIN
new.x: NPCI enabled UPI payments by fingerprint or face authentication instead of a PIN.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT among NPCI's announcements at the Global Fintech Fest, Mumbai (October 2025)?
o: A statutory 24-hour freeze mandate on stolen funds
new.x: There is no statutory 24-hour freeze mandate; the 24-hour window is only the recovery window for stolen funds.

new.s: Blackstone agreed to acquire 9.99% of which bank for ₹6,196 crore?
new.x: Blackstone took 9.99% of Federal Bank; Emirates NBD took RBL Bank and SMBC took Yes Bank.

new.s: The EPF interest rate for 2024-25 was fixed at:
new.x: The EPFO board fixed 8.25% for 2024-25, the same as 2023-24.

new.s: For October–December 2025, the interest rate on Sukanya Samriddhi was kept at:
new.x: Small-savings rates were unchanged: Sukanya Samriddhi 8.2%, NSC 7.7%, PPF 7.1%.

new.s: The "3 A's" strategy of the 'Your Capital, Your Right' campaign stands for:
new.x: The DFS-led campaign follows the 3 A's: Awareness, Accessibility, Action.

new.s: Incentives disbursed under the PLI schemes (as of March 2025) amounted to about:
new.x: ₹21,534 crore was disbursed; ₹1.76 lakh crore is investment and ₹16.5 lakh crore production/sales.

new.s: The 97 GW of new coal capacity planned by 2035 is intended to run till:
new.x: The plants are meant to run till 2050, not be phased out in 2035; net zero is targeted for 2070.

new.s: The competitiveness of Indian dairy comes mainly from:
o: A pasture-based model like New Zealand's
new.x: Indian dairy is competitive because of low labour costs, not high yields; it is smallholder and cooperative-led.

new.s: Under which Act was APEDA set up?
new.x: APEDA was set up under the APEDA Act, 1985, operative from 13 February 1986.

new.s: What fiscal deficit target did Union Budget 2025-26 set?
new.x: Budget 2025-26 targeted 4.4% of GDP; 4.8% was the 2024-25 revised estimate.

new.s: Capital expenditure in Union Budget 2025-26 was set at:
new.x: Capex was ₹11.21 lakh crore (about 3.1% of GDP); ₹50.65 lakh crore was total expenditure.

new.s: Under Union Budget 2025-26, no income tax is payable in the new regime on income up to:
new.x: Income up to ₹12 lakh is tax-free; for salaried people it is ₹12.75 lakh with the ₹75,000 standard deduction.

new.s: What was the theme of the Economic Survey 2024-25?
new.x: The Economic Survey 2024-25 focused on deregulation (Ease of Doing Business 2.0).

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Economic Survey 2024-25:
1. It was tabled on 31 January 2025.
2. It was prepared by the Department of Expenditure.
3. V. Anantha Nageswaran was the Chief Economic Adviser.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct; the Survey is prepared by the Economic Division of the Department of Economic Affairs.

new.s: What fiscal deficit target did Union Budget 2026-27 set for 2026-27?
new.x: The 2026-27 target is 4.3% of GDP (₹16.95 lakh crore); 4.4% was the 2025-26 figure.

new.s: The Economic Survey 2025-26 was tabled on:
new.x: It was tabled on 29 January 2026, two days before the Budget.

new.s: The Economic Survey 2025-26 projected India's real GDP growth for FY27 at:
new.x: The Survey projected 6.8–7.2% for FY27 and estimated 7.4% for FY26.

new.s: Union Budget 2026-27 proposed how many new NIPERs?
new.x: It proposed 3 new NIPERs and an upgrade of the existing 7.

new.s: Union Budget 2026-27 raised the allocation for the Electronics components manufacturing scheme to:
new.x: The electronics components scheme allocation was raised to ₹40,000 crore.

new.s: The SME Growth Fund announced in Union Budget 2026-27, to create "champion SMEs", is of:
new.x: The SME Growth Fund is ₹10,000 crore; the Atmanirbhar Bharat Fund gets an additional ₹2,000 crore.

new.s: How many new National Waterways did Union Budget 2026-27 propose over 5 years?
new.x: It proposed 20 new National Waterways; 7 is the number of high-speed rail corridors.

new.s: UPI was launched in 2016 under:
new.x: UPI was launched in 2016 under the National Payments Corporation of India.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (payment platform – launch) is correctly matched?
new.x: e-RUPI started on 2 August 2021; RuPay dates to 2012 and UPI to 2016.

new.s: In December 2025, the RBI cut the repo rate by 25 bps to:
new.x: The December 2025 cut took the repo to 5.25%, a cumulative 125 bps cut since February 2025.

new.s: After the 6 February 2026 policy, the Standing Deposit Facility (SDF) rate stood at:
new.x: In February 2026: repo 5.25%, SDF 5.00%, MSF and Bank Rate 5.50%.

new.s: In February 2026, the RBI raised its FY26 GDP growth projection to:
new.x: The RBI raised its FY26 GDP projection to 7.4% and put FY26 CPI at 2.1%.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Union Budget 2026-27 finance-sector proposals?
o: PFC and REC are to be restructured
An Infrastructure Risk Guarantee Fund will give partial credit guarantees to lenders
The SME Growth Fund is ₹10,000 crore
The Atmanirbhar Bharat Fund gets an additional ₹10,000 crore
new.x: The Atmanirbhar Bharat Fund gets an additional ₹2,000 crore, not ₹10,000 crore.

new.s: Under Union Budget 2026-27, STT on futures was:
new.x: STT on futures was raised from 0.02% to 0.05%; 0.15% applies to options premium and exercise.

new.s: The safe harbour margin for IT services under Union Budget 2026-27 is:
new.x: The IT-services safe harbour margin is 15.5%, with the threshold raised to ₹2,000 crore.

new.s: Who has presented the most Union Budgets (10)?
new.x: Morarji Desai presented 10 Budgets; Sitharaman and Chidambaram have 9 each.

new.s: Who moved the Budget date to 1 February and merged the Railway Budget in 2017?
new.x: Arun Jaitley did both in 2017; Yashwant Sinha changed the time to 11 AM in 1999.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (Budget record – holder) is correctly matched?
o: Longest speech by time – Nirmala Sitharaman (2020)
Longest speech by words – Nirmala Sitharaman (2020)
Most Budgets by a woman FM – Indira Gandhi
new.x: Sitharaman's 2020 speech (2 h 42 min) is the longest by time; Manmohan Singh's 1991 speech is longest by words.

new.s: Demonetisation of the ₹500 and ₹1,000 notes was announced by PM Narendra Modi on:
new.x: It was announced on the evening of 8 November 2016; the notes ceased to be legal tender from midnight.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the GST rollout:
1. GST was launched at midnight of 1 July 2017 in the Central Hall of Parliament.
2. It was based on the 101st Constitutional Amendment.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: GST was rolled out at midnight of 1 July 2017 with President Pranab Mukherjee, under the 101st Amendment.

new.s: The revised Index of Core Industries (July 2026) uses base year 2022-23 and adds which ninth industry?
new.x: The OEA, DPIIT added iron ore as the ninth core industry in the 2022-23 series.

new.s: The monthly PLFS bulletin is released by:
new.x: MoSPI releases the PLFS monthly bulletin; the first, for April 2025, came out on 15 May 2025.

new.s: Which small-savings rate stood at 8.2% for October–December 2025?
new.x: Sukanya Samriddhi was at 8.2%, NSC 7.7% and PPF 7.1%.

new.s: The EPF interest rate for 2024-25 was:
new.x: EPF interest for 2024-25 was 8.25%.

new.s: Under the Coinage Act, 2011, coins in India are issued by:
new.x: Coins are issued by the Government of India; banknotes by the RBI under Section 22 of the RBI Act.

new.s: The Urban Infrastructure Development Fund (UIDF) is funded from:
new.x: UIDF draws on the Priority Sector Lending shortfall and is run by the National Housing Bank.

new.s: The Urban Infrastructure Development Fund was announced in:
new.x: UIDF was announced in Union Budget 2023-24 for Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities.

new.s: Who was the Chief Economic Adviser for the Economic Survey 2025-26?
new.x: V. Anantha Nageswaran is the CEA; the Survey was tabled on 29 January 2026.

new.s: Which small-savings scheme carries the highest rate (8.2%) in Q1 FY27?
new.x: Sukanya Samriddhi (8.2%) is the highest; EPF's 8.25% is not a small-savings scheme.

new.s: Money collected under small-savings schemes goes to the National Small Savings Fund in the:
new.x: The NSSF sits in the Public Account, not the Consolidated Fund.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the EPF interest rate for 2025-26:
1. It was recommended by the EPFO Central Board of Trustees.
2. It was approved by the Reserve Bank of India.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Only statement 1 is correct: the CBT recommended 8.25% on 2 March 2026 and the Finance Ministry approved it.

new.s: Under the Draft RBI (Interest Rates on Loans and Advances) Directions, 2026, the external-benchmark rule applies from:
new.x: The rule for floating-rate personal and MSME loans starts on 1 April 2027, not 2026.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT part of RBI's Payments Vision 2028?
o: Shared fraud liability of sender and receiver banks
Fraud liability placed on the customer alone
new.x: Payments Vision 2028 (15 initiatives) makes sender and receiver banks share fraud liability; it does not put it on the customer alone.

new.s: On 7 October 2026, the RBI MPC changed the repo rate to:
new.x: The repo was hiked 25 bps to 5.50%, unanimously.

new.s: At the October 2026 policy, the RBI changed its stance from neutral to:
new.x: The stance moved from neutral to "calibrated tightening" along with a repo hike.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (policy rate – level, October 2026) is correctly matched?
new.x: After October 2026: repo 5.50%, SDF 5.25%, MSF and Bank Rate 5.75%.

new.s: The rebased CPI series released on 12 February 2026 has base year:
new.x: The CPI base moved from 2012 to 2024; GDP moved to 2022-23.

new.s: The new GDP (national accounts) series released on 27 February 2026 has base year:
new.x: The national accounts were rebased from 2011-12 to 2022-23.

new.s: India's Q1 FY27 (April–June 2026) GDP growth, released by NSO on 31 August 2026, was:
new.x: Q1 FY27 GDP grew 7.8%; 8.2% was real GVA and 6.9% the figure a year earlier.

new.s: After the Q1 FY27 data, ICRA raised its FY27 growth projection for India to:
new.x: ICRA raised its FY27 projection from 6.7% to 7.1%, matching the RBI.

new.s: In June 2026, Russia's share of India's crude oil imports was about:
new.x: Russia supplied about 48% of India's crude in June 2026, rising since the West Asia war.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's net GST grew 6% in 2025-26 despite a GST 2.0 revenue hit of about:
new.x: AP absorbed a ₹4,500 crore GST 2.0 hit; ₹4,000 crore is what it took from UIDF.

new.s: The SALT loan for Andhra Pradesh is from:
new.x: SALT is a World Bank loan; VCIC is backed by the ADB.
